description: A null custom metadata value on writes that create or replace an object's metadata: a multipart insert, a copy and a rewrite whose body names a source key and a new key as null, a compose destination and a PUT. The 2026-11-15 live recording shows that every one of them stores the null value as an empty string, even for a key the copy source has; only a PATCH removes a key named with null.

steps.name: source
steps.body_text:
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

{{"name":"{object}","metadata":{{"k":"v"}}}}
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
--gcsmimicdiff--

steps.name: insert-null
steps.body_text:
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

{{"name":"{object}-insert","metadata":{{"k":"v","gone":null}}}}
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
--gcsmimicdiff--
